import pytest
from attr import define, FrozenInstanceError

@define(frozen=True)
class MyException(Exception):
    message: str

def test_frozen_exception_mutation():
    exc = MyException(message="error")
    
    # These should be allowed
    exc.__suppress_context__ = True
    exc.__notes__ = "some notes"
    
    assert exc.__suppress_context__ is True
    assert exc.__notes__ == "some notes"
    
    # This should still be forbidden
    with pytest.raises(FrozenInstanceError):
        exc.message = "new message"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pytest
    pytest.main([__file__])
EOF

import attr

@attr.s(frozen=True)
class MyException(Exception):
    message = attr.ib()

exc = MyException(message="test")

# These should be allowed
exc.__suppress_context__ = True
exc.__notes__ = "some notes"

# This should still fail
try:
    exc.message = "changed"
except attr.exceptions.FrozenInstanceError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("FrozenInstanceError not raised when mutating frozen attribute")

assert exc.__suppress_context__ is True
assert exc.__notes__ == "some notes"
EOF
